title: Notes on gcd-matrix permanents, random cycle lifts, and d-matching polynomials, with Lean 4 formalizations
description: Four short notes in number theory and combinatorics, with a methodology note, by Vico Bonfioli. (1) The permanent of the GCD matrix a(n)=per[gcd(i,j)] (OEIS A085244): a family of congruences, v2(a(n)) tending to infinity, and bounds on the growth of (a(n)/n!)^(1/n); whether the 2-adic deficit is unbounded is left open. (2) A short elementary derivation of the expected characteristic polynomial of a random permutation r-lift of a cycle. (3) Coefficient stability of d-matching polynomials. (4) Integers n with n dividing p(n)-1. Formalization scope varies by result: the accompanying Lean 4 / Mathlib library builds with no sorry and machine-checks the gcd-permanent congruences and 2-adic bounds and the cycle-lift main theorem, while the growth bounds and the matching-coefficient results are ordinary paper proofs.
